description: Create a new data source from an inline base64-encoded file (CSV, TSV, JSON, Excel, TXT, PDF). The file goes through the same validation and preprocessing as a web upload. Returns the data_source_id you can pass to run_analysis as soon as preprocessing completes (poll get_data_source_schema for readiness or pass wait_seconds to block here).

data_base64.description: Base64-encoded file contents. Maximum 25 MB encoded (~18 MB raw). For larger payloads, host the file at a public URL and use ingest_url_data_source.

description.description: Optional human-readable description. Surfaces in the web app and in get_data_source_schema.

format.description: File format. Drives MIME detection and the preprocessing route inside clariBI. csv covers comma-separated; tsv is tab-separated; xlsx is modern Excel; json must be a top-level array of objects or a single object.

name.description: Display name for the new data source. Shown in the web app and in subsequent list_data_sources calls.

wait_seconds.description: How long (seconds) to wait for preprocessing to finish before returning. 0 returns immediately with status="preprocessing"; the caller polls get_data_source_schema or list_data_sources.

name: upload_data_source
